title: ID0428879-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Multiple]Broken cable
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
we would like to report broken cable management system on all 3
chargers at our site Horni Pocernice. Tape used under the clamp
started slipping apart therefore cable is not firmly attach to the
clamp anymore and cable is on the ground.
Note that during installation we take care how many turns to do
with that tape. Since this is happening on multiple sides of ours we
conclude is is the design flaw.
Thank you for creating the ticket.
Once it is open I will report how we solved it and claim the costs.
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-04-22
